treatment: FT reporting relayed by Reuters; not independently verified by Reuters. Repeat only for official confirmation, amended contract, construction timeline, or material capacity changes.
known_facts: Reuters reported at 12:54 UTC Nov 8 that FT described approximately $3.4B generator commitments for 1.7GW purchased from OnePWR in late September.
This is a generator commitment, not acquisition of OnePWR; no employees transferred.
Reuters could not independently verify and neither party commented.
reinclude_only_if: Material change in financial or energy terms
notes: New reporting published after 12:00 JST; underlying deal dates to September.
